# UDPMsgIP

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

```blitzbasic
UDPMsgIP udp_stream%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | Int | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address of the sender of the last message that [RecvUDPMsg](RecvUDPMsg) received.
